title: The 'call it a draw between them' companion-dispute option is framed as a fair mediation, but a failed will roll (which happened twice) causes BOTH companions to disapprove simultaneously, a harsher penalty than just picking a side outright.
where: companion dialogue after resting a hold (e.g. The Empty Seat, The Old Court)
